The Si–P bond lengths remain almost unchanged, supporting retention of the covalent network while Cd changes its polarizability. |
| **2** | **c073** | CdIn₃AsTe₄ | **High-SHG endpoint.** Its **P1 tetrahedral framework** closely matches training ZnIn₃AsSe₄, with strongly reinforcing bond orientations. Training CdGa₂Se₄ → CdGa₂Te₄ shows SHG increasing from **41.7 to 91.7 pm/V**, accompanied by a smaller gap. | **3** | **c051** | ZnGa₂S₄ | **Wider-gap, appreciable-SHG anchor.** Its **I-4 structure** contains coherently oriented ZnS₄ and GaS₄ tetrahedra. | **4** | **c055** | AlGaAs₂ | **Intermediate frontier coverage.** Its ordered **R3m, zincblende-derived network** has nearly regular, coherently oriented tetrahedra.
